changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO role_resources (role_id, resource_id, created_date, created_by) SELECT DISTINCT r.id, res.id, NOW(), 'system' FROM (VALUES ('ADMIN','GOODS_RECEIPTS'), ('FOREMAN','GOODS_RECEIPTS'), ('MANAGER','GOODS_RECEIPTS'), ('BUYER','GOODS_RECEIPTS') ) g(role_code, res_code) JOIN roles r ON r.code = g.role_code JOIN resources res ON res.code = g.res_code WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM role_resources x WHERE x.role_id = r.id AND x.resource_id = res.id );

INSERT INTO role_resource_operations (role_resource_id, operation_id) SELECT rr.id, o.id FROM (VALUES ('ADMIN','GOODS_RECEIPTS','CREATE'), ('ADMIN','GOODS_RECEIPTS','READ'), ('ADMIN','GOODS_RECEIPTS','UPDATE'), ('ADMIN','GOODS_RECEIPTS','DELETE'), ('FOREMAN','GOODS_RECEIPTS','CREATE'), ('FOREMAN','GOODS_RECEIPTS','READ'), ('FOREMAN','GOODS_RECEIPTS','UPDATE'), ('MANAGER','GOODS_RECEIPTS','CREATE'), ('MANAGER','GOODS_RECEIPTS','READ'), ('MANAGER','GOODS_RECEIPTS','UPDATE'), ('BUYER','GOODS_RECEIPTS','READ') ) g(role_code, res_code, op_code) JOIN roles r ON r.code = g.role_code JOIN resources res ON res.code = g.res_code JOIN role_resources rr ON rr.role_id = r.id AND rr.resource_id = res.id JOIN operations o ON o.code = g.op_code WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM role_resource_operations x WHERE x.role_resource_id = rr.id AND x.operation_id = o.id );
